notes.title: Major Update for Tales of Terror!
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to announce this update and confident it will provide a delightful and captivating experience for you and your friends!

Here are the major changes for this patch:

Adjusted Difficulty: The game's overall difficulty has been modified to enhance accessibility and enjoyment for all players.

Enhanced Pacing: The game's progression has been refined, ensuring a more natural build-up of action and challenges.

Bugs and Fatal Crashes: We believe the major bugs in the game have been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 3.04
notes.notes:
Easier Difficulty: We've adjusted the overall difficulty to make the game more accessible and enjoyable for everyone.

Better Pacing: We've smoothed out the flow of the game, so the action and challenges build more naturally.

notes.title: Patch 3.03 Game Improvements
notes.notes:
Game Update: Key Fixes and Improvements

Portal Entity Behavior: The portal entity no longer locks on and chases the player, allowing you to hide successfully.

Fatal Error Resolution: Resolved fatal errors caused by maxing out virtual memory, ensuring a smoother gameplay experience.

Ambient Sound Adjustments: Lowered ambient sound levels for a more balanced audio experience.

Quality of Life Enhancements: Fixed various minor bugs to improve overall gameplay quality.

notes.title: Patch 3.02 Difficulty Changes
notes.notes: Made difficulty changes based on beta tester feedback, thank you for your support!

notes.title: Small Bug Fixes
notes.notes: Cleaned up collisions and bug allowing players to duplicate items

notes.title: Patch 3.0
notes.notes: Prepare for terror as Patch 3.0 descends upon our game, unleashing smoother frames, intensified audio, and enhanced player communication to plunge you deeper into the abyss. Encounter new monsters lurking in the shadows, express your fear with bone-chilling emotes, and wield new items against the encroaching darkness. With optimized performance, the horrors have never been more visceral. Brace yourself for a journey into madness like no other.

notes.title: Tales of Terror 1st Update Patch!
notes.notes:
First of all we just wanted to say thanks for playing Tales of Terror!  

We have been working hard and have finally released our first patch of the game.  Let us know what you think!   Feel free to join our Discord [url=https://discord.gg/mFerYhZhqZ]here[/url]. 

[b]Please keep in mind this game is still in early access[/b]


Patch Notes :
[list]
[*] Lobby audio now fixed 
[*] Mute buttons now functional
[*] Difficulty lowered in many areas - especially on easy
[*] Sound fixes on monster animations (sound volumes are now in line with all other sounds)
[*] Added new Achievements - fixed all old achievements that were not working
[*] Decryption now adjusted for other languages (uses numbers instead of english characters)
[*] Better descriptions for all items
[*] First floor visuals updated
[*] Fixed issue with fatal crash to and from lobby
[*] Various bugs cleaned up
[/list]

notes.title: Tales of Terror is now Available for Early Access!
notes.notes:
We have so many plans in the future for this game such as new levels, PVP, and more. Of course we will continue to work on any issues as well as polish what we currently have.  Join us as we continue making updates to make this one of the best horror games out there!  



We encourage all players to join our discord [url=https://discord.gg/mFerYhZhqZ]here[/url].  

If there are any bugs, issues, or game recommendations you can report them at our discord page.
